title.zh: 广交会境外采购商预登记

entries.text_zh: 所有到会的境外采购商都应在广交会官网或 App 的采购商服务系统（buyer.cantonfair.org.cn）预登记，预登记全年开放：首次到会先注册账号、填写到会意向，再按需申请采购商证件和邀请函；已到过会的采购商登录后填写到会意向，按需申请邀请函。预登记后可在白云机场、广州南站、琶洲港澳客运码头、广州指定酒店及广交会驻香港办事处等馆外办证点免费领证，也可在展馆采购商登记处领证。馆外办证点只受理外国护照和港澳台居民来往内地通行证；持中国护照加境外永久居留证或签证的华侨须到展馆登记处领证。各届日期和办证点时段以官网当届通知为准。
entries.text_en: All overseas buyers attending the fair onsite should pre-register in the Buyer Service System on the Canton Fair website or app (buyer.cantonfair.org.cn); pre-registration opens year-round. First-time attendees create an account, complete their attendance intent, then apply for a Buyer Badge and invitation letter as needed; returning buyers log in, complete their attendance intent and apply for an invitation letter as needed. After pre-registering, badges can be collected free of charge at alternative registration offices such as Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport, Guangzhou South Railway Station, the Pazhou Ferry Terminal, designated hotels in Guangzhou and the Canton Fair Hong Kong Representative Office, or at the buyer registration offices at the Complex. Alternative offices only serve holders of foreign passports or Mainland Travel Permits for Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan residents; overseas Chinese with a Chinese passport plus an overseas permanent residence permit or visa must collect their badge at the Complex. Dates and office hours for each session follow that session’s official notice.

title.en: Getting to the Canton Fair Complex in Pazhou

entries.text_zh: 去琶洲广交会展馆，广州市公安局建议乘地铁：8 号线琶洲站或新港东站，或 11 号线琶洲站，也可乘公交。展会期间展馆周边实施交通管制，出租车和网约车在指定上客点上车，具体地点和时段以广州市公安局当届公告为准。
entries.text_en: For the Canton Fair Complex in Pazhou, the Guangzhou Public Security Bureau recommends the metro (Pazhou or Xingangdong station on Line 8, or Pazhou station on Line 11) or buses. During the fair, traffic around the Complex is controlled and taxis and ride-hailing cars pick up at designated points; the places and hours follow the bureau’s notice for that session.

title.en: Visa channels for attending the fair

entries.text_zh: 需要签证来华参会的采购商，可用在广交会采购商服务系统申请的邀请函办理来华签证。签证种类、免签和过境免签安排本条不作判断，以中国驻外使领馆和国家移民管理局的最新公布为准。
entries.text_en: Buyers who need a visa to attend can use the Canton Fair invitation letter, applied for in the Buyer Service System, to apply for a China visa. This entry does not decide visa types, visa-free entry or visa-free transit; follow the latest announcements of Chinese embassies and consulates and the National Immigration Administration.
